4d511dfac119d3f6.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager, Payments Infrastructure based in Saudi Arabia. As a Product Manager, Payments Infrastructure, you will shape the core systems that enable secure, reliable, and scalable money movement across multiple markets and currencies. You will own the technical roadmap for payment processing, settlement, ledger systems, virtual accounts, and banking integrations. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Treasury, and Compliance, you will ensure transactions are processed accurately, efficiently, and on time. You will help optimize payment routing, liquidity management, and cross-border settlement across traditional banking and stablecoin networks. This role offers the opportunity to influence critical infrastructure decisions in a fast-moving fintech environment serving emerging markets. You will combine technical product expertise with strategic thinking to strengthen system resilience, expand payment capabilities, and support sustainable growth. Accountabilities Own and execute the technical roadmap for core payment infrastructure, including payment rails, ledger systems, settlement engines, currency conversion, and virtual account capabilities. Lead the development of virtual accounts and Virtual IBAN infrastructure to support customer-facing payment experiences and evolving business needs. Collaborate with the Payment Experience Product Manager to align infrastructure capabilities with customer requirements and translate upcoming product needs into technical priorities. Evaluate, prioritize, and oversee integrations with banking partners, liquidity providers, and stablecoin settlement networks, balancing cost, speed, reliability, and market coverage. Own transaction processing, settlement, and reconciliation systems to ensure accurate, timely, and reliable movement of funds across multiple currencies and payment networks. Define payment routing and currency conversion strategies, selecting the most appropriate rails for individual transactions and supporting settlement through networks such as USDC, USDT, and PYUSD. Partner with Engineering on architecture decisions involving APIs, distributed systems, data consistency, idempotency, error handling, and reconciliation. Work with Treasury to incorporate liquidity requirements, funding models, and payment corridor coverage into infrastructure design. Collaborate with Compliance to embed regulatory, licensing, and market-specific requirements into payment infrastructure from the outset. Define and monitor infrastructure performance metrics, including transaction success rates, settlement times, system uptime, reconciliation accuracy, and incident frequency and severity. Work with Engineering on capacity planning, incident response, scalability improvements, and the prioritization of technical debt that could affect reliability or future growth. Document infrastructure capabilities, limitations, partner integrations, and corridor-specific requirements to support Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams. Requirements At least 5 years of Product Management experience, including 3 or more years working with payment infrastructure, payment rails, ledger systems, or core banking and transaction platforms within fintech or crypto. Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage in detailed architecture discussions covering APIs, distributed systems, data consistency, transaction processing, and system reliability. A bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Product Management, or a related field. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams across different disciplines, markets, and time zones. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing demands, meet deadlines, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to make informed trade-offs between speed, cost, scalability, and reliability when defining technical product priorities. Experience with stablecoin or cryptocurrency settlement networks is a plus. Experience integrating banking partners, working with correspondent banking networks, or managing cross-border payment rails is a plus. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex infrastructure capabilities and technical constraints to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Benefits Meaningful impact: Contribute to expanding financial inclusion and improving access to financial infrastructure across emerging markets. Remote-first flexibility: Work in a fully remote environment. International collaboration: Join a diverse, multicultural team of professionals working across more than 25 countries. Learning and development: Access resources, support, and autonomy to develop your skills and advance your career. Mental health support: Benefit from services designed to support your mental well-being. Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package aligned with the role and experience. Health coverage: Access meaningful healthcare benefits. Equity participation: Participate in the stock option plan available to full-time employees. Full-time opportunity: Take ownership of critical payment infrastructure initiatives with opportunities to influence technical strategy and long-term product development. 4dd095236145870d.description: Job description . Department Marketing, KSA affiliate, International Operations Your impact begins here As Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing, you will own the integrated brand and portfolio strategy for our diabetes business in Saudi Arabia. You will turn affiliate priorities into clear growth, market-share and return-on-investment objectives, and lead a team that connects strategy, market development and field execution. From launch readiness to new channels and partnerships, your decisions will shape how our treatments reach healthcare professionals and people living with diabetes across KSA. What you’ll bring You are a commercial leader who sets direction, makes clear choices and delivers through others. You will bring: A relevant academic degree in medicine, pharmacy, science or business. Fluent written and spoken English. Strong brand, portfolio, lifecycle, go-to-market and omnichannel / multichannel engagement capability. Strong business, commercial and financial acumen, and a data-driven approach to decisions. The ability to translate strategy into clear priorities and deliver results through others. Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills. A high patient and science orientation, with sound judgement across growth, evidence, access and compliance. What you’ll do You will set the strategic direction for the brand and portfolio plan, lead the team that brings it to life, and expand the market, channels and partnerships that drive sustainable growth. Lead in-depth analysis of market dynamics, prescribing habits, the competitive and access landscape and how patients and customers move through care – then define the annual and long-term brand and portfolio strategy, priority segments and go-to-market approach. Own the marketing budget and resource allocation, investing in the highest-impact initiatives. Set KPIs and governance to track forecasts, sales, market share, share of growth, customer engagement and campaign ROI, and act quickly when performance deviates. Integrate HCP, KOL/DOL, consumer, pharmacy and e-health touchpoints into coordinated omnichannel plans with clear content calendars, KPIs and owners – and make sure Sales and other execution teams understand the strategy, with training and feedback loops. Spend at least 20% of your time with target customers, working alongside the sales force on a regular visit plan. Identify growth whitespace, strategic accounts, new channels and partnerships; lead counterstrategies, lifecycle actions and launch readiness, including future indications and formulations. Direct external agencies, vendors and partners with clear briefs, governance, performance measures and budget discipline, so execution is high quality and compliant with Novo Nordisk policies and local regulations. Minimum requirements 3-4 years of brand management experience. Experience in diabetes therapy area is preferred. Portfolio management is an advantage. Previous track record with a team of direct reports is a plus. Who you’ll work with You will join the Marketing team in the KSA affiliate, part of International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to the Cardiometabolic Associate Director for HCP Marketing Your closest partners will be Sales, Medical, Market Access & Public Affairs, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement and People & Organisation, as well as Business Area and Region leadership. You will represent Commercial Marketing in cross-functional governance, bringing these teams together so decisions are aligned across the product life cycle. Outside Novo Nordisk, you will build relationships with key and digital opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, scientific societies, hospitals, patient advocacy groups and strategic commercial partners across KSA. What you can expect here You will be trusted to own decisions. Within agreed objectives and budget governance, you will set direction, allocate resources and approve or recommend priorities and investments – and you will see the results of those choices in the market. You will work with advanced analytics, market intelligence and AI-enabled tools, and lead experiments with new channels, digital health and omnichannel engagement, scaling what delivers measurable value. Clear performance expectations, honest feedback and a culture that rewards results will support you to grow as a leader while your team grows with you. Start now Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead brand strategy that turns insight into progress for people living with diabetes in Saudi Arabia, apply for the Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing role by 21 October 2026. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

4d241a74e13b117a.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Manager - Landscape Maintenance for Botanica, its subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery. Botanica integrates new species with local flora across Red Sea Global’s destinations, covering over 1 million square meters. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, focusing on ecological harmony and sustainable development within The Red Sea & Amaala projects. This is a full-time position for candidates with 5-10 years of experience. Role Overview The Manager - Landscape Maintenance will oversee landscape maintenance operations across assigned sites. This role involves ensuring high-quality landscape presentation, plant health, irrigation performance, and operational efficiency. The Manager will also be responsible for HSE compliance and achieving service standards, leading Supervisors and field teams, managing resources, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and clients for effective service delivery. Key Responsibilities Manage daily landscape maintenance operations and develop weekly and monthly maintenance plans. Lead and supervise Landscape Maintenance Supervisors, technical teams, gardeners, and the field workforce. Oversee all softscape and horticultural activities, including pruning, mowing, planting, fertilization, weeding, mulching, and plant replacement. Monitor plant health and landscape quality, implementing corrective actions for pests, diseases, and nutrient deficiencies. Oversee irrigation performance, coordinate with irrigation teams, and improve water-use efficiency. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure landscape areas meet quality and service standards. Manage manpower planning, workforce deployment, productivity, attendance, and utilization. Monitor landscape maintenance KPIs, work orders, service requests, and client observations. Manage requirements for plants, fertilizers, chemicals, soil, tools, machinery, and vehicles. Coordinate purchase requisitions and material requirements with Procurement and support functions. Review and validate operational invoices and supporting documentation. Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with scope, quality, and safety. Ensure effective utilization and maintenance of landscape machinery and equipment. Ensure full compliance with HSE requirements, environmental standards, and safe working practices. Coordinate with Nursery, Irrigation, HSE, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, Facilities, HR, and other operational teams. Maintain communication with clients and stakeholders, addressing operational concerns. Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. Monitor operational costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Support mobilization and operational readiness for new landscape maintenance areas. Identify operational risks, manpower gaps, and quality concerns, escalating critical matters to the Senior Manager. Coach and develop Supervisors and field teams to strengthen technical capability and team performance. Drive continuous improvement in landscape quality, sustainability, and service delivery. Ensure all landscape maintenance activities achieve business objectives, client expectations, and contractual requirements. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in landscape maintenance management. Demonstrated ability to manage landscape operations, teams, and resources effectively. Experience in ensuring compliance with HSE and environmental standards. Proficiency in developing and implementing maintenance plans and schedules. Work Environment and Collaboration This role involves close coordination with various internal departments, including Admin, Legal, Finance, Projects, Procurement, Compensation, IT, Marketing, Audit, and HR, to ensure integrated operational support and effective service delivery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. Why Join Red Sea Global? Contribute to large-scale sustainability projects focused on transforming landscapes and preserving biodiversity. Work with industry experts in a dynamic environment. Be part of a company that is shaping sustainable tourism and development. Contribute to projects in natural locations.

4d2a7711d1844d49.description: We are seeking a passionate and skilled Barista to join our dynamic team and create exceptional coffee experiences for our customers. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting a variety of coffee beverages, maintaining a clean and organized work environment, and providing friendly and efficient customer service. If you have a love for coffee and enjoy interacting with people, we encourage you to apply. Responsibilities: * Prepare and serve a wide range of coffee and espresso-based drinks according to established recipes and quality standards. * Engage with customers in a welcoming and professional manner, taking orders accurately and making recommendations. * Maintain cleanliness and organization of the coffee bar, equipment, and service areas. * Operate and maintain coffee brewing equipment, ensuring it is in good working order. * Manage inventory of coffee beans, milk, syrups, and other supplies, and report needs for restocking. * Adhere to all food safety and hygiene regulations. The job is for 3 months. Minimum experience 1 year.
