4d3755701e84c11d.description: KPMG Audit Internship Program for Accounting Graduates KPMG is offering an Audit Internship Program for Accounting graduates in Jeddah, Medina, and Al Khobar. This program is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are ready to apply their academic knowledge in a professional audit environment. The internship provides practical experience and exposure to the professional services sector. About KPMG KPMG is a professional service provider in the Middle East, offering services across audit, tax, and advisory. The firm's Middle East workforce comprises over 5,000 professionals. KPMG operates with experienced leadership and dedicated regional teams, leveraging professional talent, technologies, and solutions to meet client needs. The company aims to be recognized as a transformed firm, trusted by its people, clients, and society. Program Overview The Audit Internship Program focuses on building a foundation for a career in audit. Interns will gain hands-on experience and develop technical and professional skills relevant to the field. The program also provides meaningful exposure to the professional services environment, contributing to the intern's professional profile. Key Learning Opportunities Gaining practical experience in audit functions. Developing technical and professional skills applicable to the audit sector. Strengthening professional credentials through real-world application. Obtaining exposure to the professional services industry. Candidate Requirements Accounting graduate. 0-1 years of professional experience. Readiness to apply academic knowledge in a professional setting. KPMG's Commitment KPMG supports equal opportunities for all candidates and is committed to providing personal and professional development for its employees. The firm fosters a supportive environment that respects individual differences and prioritizes employee well-being through work-life balance initiatives.

4d6231110eb6c3a0.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking an experienced Associate / Principal Strategic Urban Planner to join the Planning and Urban Development team. This full-time position involves delivering complex strategic planning, urban development, and master planning assignments across the Middle East. The role requires strong expertise in strategic planning, spatial planning, land-use planning, development frameworks, and urban policy. Key Responsibilities Lead and contribute to strategic urban planning, regional planning, city planning, and master planning projects. Develop strategic spatial frameworks, land-use strategies, development frameworks, growth scenarios, and planning policies. Undertake analysis of existing urban conditions, demographics, land use, infrastructure, mobility, environmental constraints, and development opportunities. Prepare urban growth strategies, spatial development plans, structure plans, and strategic planning frameworks. Translate strategic objectives and development visions into practical spatial and land-use recommendations. Coordinate urban planning activities with transport, infrastructure, environmental, landscape, economic, and urban design disciplines. Conduct planning assessments, benchmarking studies, development capacity assessments, and planning policy reviews. Support the development of planning regulations, development controls, zoning strategies, planning guidelines, and implementation frameworks. Evaluate alternative development scenarios and provide evidence-based recommendations to clients. Lead or support stakeholder engagement workshops with government authorities, developers, municipalities, and other key stakeholders. Prepare high-quality technical reports, planning strategies, presentations, and client deliverables. Manage project scope, programme, resources, technical quality, and planning deliverables. Review work produced by planners and junior team members, ensuring technical accuracy and consistency. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level urban planning professionals. Maintain an understanding of emerging trends in sustainable urban development, smart cities, transit-oriented development, climate resilience, and integrated planning. Contribute to proposals, bids, technical methodologies, fee estimates, and business development activities. Required Expertise The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to translate economic, social, environmental, and infrastructure considerations into integrated and implementable planning strategies. This includes a strong foundation in strategic planning, spatial planning, land-use planning, development frameworks, and urban policy.

4d6995c676c6f896.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Deputy Construction Manager – Residential Zone to join our team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and supports the Construction Manager in overseeing all residential construction activities within a mixed-use development. The role focuses on daily coordination, progress monitoring, and technical oversight of contractors to ensure timely, high-quality, and cost-effective delivery of residential components in line with client requirements. Key Responsibilities Assist in reviewing construction projects, phasing, and milestones for residential blocks. Coordinate with design consultants to verify completeness and constructability of architectural, structural, and MEP drawings for residential areas. Identify construction risks specific to residential zones (towers, mid-rise, low-rise) and propose mitigation measures. Supervise day-to-day construction activities for assigned residential buildings/sections. Monitor progress against the approved baseline schedule and highlight delays or critical issues to the Construction Manager. Ensure works are executed strictly as per approved drawings, method statements, and specifications. Coordinate with MEP, façade, and finishes teams to ensure proper sequencing and interface management in residential units and common areas. Implement QA/QC procedures on site for structural, architectural, and MEP residential works. Support snagging and de-snagging activities for units, corridors, lobbies, and common amenities. Assist the QS/Contracts team and Construction Manager in monitoring quantities and verifying works executed for residential areas. Help maintain records of site instructions, change orders, and potential claims related to residential works. Provide site-based inputs to support negotiation and settlement of residential-specific commercial issues. Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Compliance Ensure implementation of project HSE plans by contractors in all residential zones. Monitor compliance with PPE requirements and safe work practices (work at height, scaffolding, lifting, hot works). Report unsafe conditions, incidents, and near misses; support investigations and corrective actions. Encourage a strong safety culture among site teams and workers. Coordination and Stakeholder Management Coordinate daily with project stakeholders including the Main Contractor’s residential construction team, MEP and façade contractors, and PMC discipline leads (Structural, MEP, HSE, Planning, QS). Facilitate resolution of RFIs, site queries, and design clarifications related to residential works. Support communication and updates to the client’s representative regarding progress, risks, and issues in residential packages. Help manage interfaces with residential amenities (clubhouse, parks, pools), podium/parking structures, and external works (roads, landscaping). Handover and Reporting Assist in coordinating testing and commissioning of MEP services in residential units and common areas. Support inspections for unit completion, pre-handover checks, and defect lists. Help ensure all documentation for residential handover is prepared. Participate in joint inspections with client and facility management teams before handover. Act as an on-site representative safeguarding client interests in residential construction activities. Provide regular, structured reports and dashboards to the Construction Manager on residential progress, risks, and resource requirements. Support enforcement of PMC procedures, approvals workflow, and documentation standards. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in construction management, preferably within residential zones of mixed-use developments. The position requires a professional who can operate effectively in a PMC capacity, focusing on technical oversight and coordination to ensure project delivery in Jeddah and Makkah.

4d91bf6dc8f30ae7.description: About Foreground Foreground is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) in Riyadh. The client is a digital-first organization that operates critical platforms with high data sensitivity and significant regulatory oversight. Cybersecurity is a strategic priority for the business. The Role of Chief Information Security Officer The Chief Information Security Officer will be responsible for leading the enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy, risk management, and compliance initiatives. This full-time role involves overseeing security architecture, governance frameworks, and incident response. A primary objective is to ensure the alignment of the cybersecurity posture with regulatory and national standards. The CISO will also advise executive leadership and the board on matters of cyber risk and resilience. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and implementation of enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy. Manage cyber risk and ensure compliance with relevant regulations and national standards. Oversee the design and implementation of security architecture and governance frameworks. Direct incident response planning and execution. Advise executive leadership and the board on cyber risk and resilience. Manage relationships with third-party security providers and internal security teams. Candidate Profile and Requirements Demonstrated senior cybersecurity leadership experience within regulated or enterprise environments. Strong exposure to risk frameworks, compliance, and security operations. Experience in Saudi Arabia or similar regulatory markets is highly preferred. Ability to combine technical depth with effective executive communication skills. Relevant industry certifications are strongly valued. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on critical platforms with high data sensitivity and regulatory oversight. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this Chief Information Security Officer role.

4da555eebbabbf82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الوجهة السياحية المميزة عن أخصائي إدارة خدمات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحليل الخدمات وتطوير الخطط التشغيلية لتحسين فعاليتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الخدمات لتحديد الاحتياجات وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية. تحسين فعالية الخدمات وتقديم الحلول المناسبة للتحديات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات، وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة. عرض التقارير والوثائق على المعنيين ومناقشتها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. دراسة التجارب والممارسات العالمية في إدارة الخدمات وتقييم جدوى الاستفادة منها. رفع التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات في مجال إدارة الخدمات. تحليل العمليات والإجراءات التفصيلية لضمان تكاملها وترابطها وسلامة مساراتها التدفقية. ضمان تقديم الخدمات ضمن أعلى معايير الكفاءة والجودة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة المستجدات في المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة الخدمات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد الاحتياجات التشغيلية والتطويرية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على التخطيط الاستراتيجي والتشغيلي للخدمات. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات والتقنيات الحديثة في مجال إدارة الخدمات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الكفاءة والجودة في تقديم الخدمات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4dcdb3a36d57cd5c.description: We are announcing a job opportunity for the position of HR Operations Specialist to join our team. We are looking for a candidate with experience and competence in managing day-to-day HR operations, with familiarity with Saudi Labor Law and related government platforms. Tasks and Responsibilities: Executing and managing employee-related HR operations, from recruitment and onboarding to offboarding. Preparing employment contracts, following up on their documentation and renewal, and completing onboarding and end-of-service procedures. Managing employee files, ensuring they are complete and continuously updated. Tracking leaves, attendance, and timekeeping, and updating relevant records. Executing and following up on procedures via government platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and MUDAD. Preparing and issuing letters, employment certificates, and employee-related documents. Ensuring compliance with company policies, Saudi Labor Law, and its executive regulations. Preparing periodic HR operations reports and contributing to process improvement and efficiency. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Practical experience in HR operations is an essential requirement . Excellent knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and its executive regulations. Experience in dealing with government platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and MUDAD. Proficiency in using HR systems and Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel. High organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize. Accuracy in work and maintaining the confidentiality of employee data. Effective communication skills and the ability to work within a team.

4de82262ae932e07.description: ممثل مبيعات – بوثات اتصالات نبحث عن ممثلة مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقنا والعمل في بوثات اتصالات داخل الأسواق. المميزات: راتب أساسي + عمولات مجزية التوظيف في أقرب حي سكني سلم وظيفي وفرص للتطور والترقي تدريب وتأهيل حتى إتقان العمل مكافآت وحوافز للمتميزات وتحقيق الأهداف

4d00307acfad70e2.description: About the Company: Skyworth Group is a leading global consumer electronics and smart home brand, with strong business presence across TVs, home appliances, energy storage, and smart devices worldwide. About the Role: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Market Assistant to support our marketing operations in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will work closely with the local marketing team on retailer training, content localization, social media support, and campaign execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in both Arabic and English, familiar with the Saudi market, and able to turn daily frontline insights into actionable input for the broader team. Key Responsibilities: Support daily sales associate training, including the preparation, translation, and localization of training materials such as product highlights and sales scripts. Translate and localize marketing assets between Arabic and English (and Chinese when needed), including product collateral, posters, POSM, training materials, and promotional content. Assist with social media operations by organizing product images, videos, copywriting, and other marketing assets. Support the execution and follow-up of new product launches, promotional campaigns, and other marketing activities. Collect, organize, and report frontline feedback on the market, competitors, and sales associates. Handle other tasks assigned by the Marketing Lead. Qualifications: Languages: Full professional fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is required. Chinese language skills are a strong plus. Experience: Prior experience in marketing, retail, consumer electronics, or a related field is preferred. Background: Experience in sales associate training, social media operations, or marketing campaign execution is a plus. Market Knowledge: Familiarity with the Saudi market and local culture, with strong communication, coordination, and execution skills. Mindset: A self-starter who is responsible, proactive, and able to drive tasks independently to completion.

4d1627fec7d9b4c4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة غذاء المستهلك عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع الترويجية للمنتجات (السلع والخدمات)، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة وتحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات بناء العلاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. الدقة في تحصيل الديون وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يتطلب الدور زيارات ميدانية للعملاء والتواصل المباشر معهم لترويج المنتجات وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

4da48f8cd01b82d4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حافة البناء عن مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتنفيذ إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وتحديد المخاطر، وضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى إعداد وتطوير الأسس والقواعد والإجراءات الخاصة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل. يشمل ذلك تحديد الأخطار المهنية ووضع إجراءات تفاديها، بالإضافة إلى توفير مستلزمات وأدوات السلامة ومتابعة استخدامها. كما يتولى المهندس إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال لضمان الامتثال للمعايير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنفيذ خطة السلامة والصحة المهنية الخاصة بالمشروع. متابعة تطبيق إجراءات ومتطلبات السلامة في الموقع بشكل مستمر. إجراء التفتيشات الدورية لتحديد المخاطر واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد تقييمات المخاطر وخطط الطوارئ للتعامل مع الحالات غير المتوقعة. التحقيق في الحوادث والمخالفات وإعداد التقارير اللازمة لتوثيقها وتحليلها. إجراء اجتماعات وتدريبات السلامة للعاملين والمقاولين لرفع مستوى الوعي. التأكد من استخدام معدات الوقاية الشخصية والالتزام بإجراءات العمل الآمنة. التنسيق مع إدارة المشروع والاستشاري والعميل فيما يخص جميع متطلبات السلامة. متابعة سجلات وتصاريح العمل وتقارير السلامة الدورية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. فهم عميق لأسس وقواعد وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد الأخطار المهنية ووضع حلول فعالة لتفاديها. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة عمل تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العالية والتنسيق المستمر مع مختلف الأطراف المعنية بالمشروع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

4dbbfb38527bed4d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث وكالة وقت الاجازة للسفر و السياحة عن منظم سياحي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتصميم وتنظيم وتسويق البرامج السياحية المتنوعة، مع ضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية ترتيب خدمات التأمين أثناء السفر مع شركات التأمين المرخصة، بعد الحصول على موافقة الجهات المختصة. تصميم وتنظيم وتسويق الرحلات والبرامج السياحية المختلفة. ترتيب خدمات الترفيه والإرشاد السياحي والإقامة والإيواء السياحي. تسعير البرامج السياحية بالتنسيق مع الشركة السياحية. التأكد من نجاح سير البرنامج السياحي كما هو مخطط له مسبقًا، ومراقبة مستوى الخدمات المقدمة للعملاء. التقيد بالأنظمة والتعليمات المتعلقة بالنواحي الأمنية أثناء تنفيذ البرامج. تسجيل البيانات الخاصة بالعملاء والخدمات التي سيتم تنفيذها وتسويقها وفقًا لتعليمات الجهات المختصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال تنظيم الرحلات السياحية أو دور مماثل. فهم جيد لمتطلبات تنظيم البرامج السياحية وخدمات السفر. القدرة على التنسيق مع مختلف الجهات والشركات لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المنظم السياحي ضمن فريق متخصص في وكالة وقت الاجازة للسفر و السياحة، مع التركيز على تقديم تجارب سفر مميزة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4d444b1c0a9d858c.job_title: Director of Sustainability Six Senses Southern Dunes The Red Sea
4d444b1c0a9d858c.description: About the Role Nesma & Partners Contracting Co. Ltd. is seeking a Sustainability Manager to join their team in Al Khobar. This full-time position involves leading the sustainability department and ensuring the effective implementation of strategic objectives. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Strategic Contribution and Leadership The Sustainability Manager will be responsible for cascading the departmental strategy into operational plans, ensuring alignment and integration with other departmental strategies. This role involves leading the sustainability department to achieve its objectives through effective management and talent development. Key Responsibilities Ensure effective cascading of the Sustainability departmental strategy into operating plans to ensure vertical alignment and horizontal integration with other interfacing departmental strategies. Manage the effective achievement of Sustainability objectives through the leadership of the Sustainability department by setting individual objectives, managing performance, and developing, and motivating staff to maximize sectional performance. Lead the talent development initiatives for the Sustainability department, collaborating with technical/discipline experts and thereby ensuring the availability of talent to fit business requirements. Act as a role model and drive adherence to organizational values and ethics by employees of the Sustainability department to foster a value-driven culture within the organization. Manage the preparation, recommend the department budget, and monitor financial performance versus the budget while ensuring all sectional activities are conducted in line with the approved guidelines. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 7 to 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven ability to manage and lead a department effectively. Experience in strategic planning and budget management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, within Nesma & Partners Contracting Co. Ltd. The role involves working within a professional environment focused on achieving sustainability objectives and fostering a value-driven culture. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4d449c4a29cb638a.description: About the Role Antal International is seeking a Sales Manager – Dates for a prominent dates producer in Saudi Arabia. Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, this full-time role is responsible for leading sales and business development activities across Saudi Arabia and international markets. The primary focus is on growing revenue, developing strategic customer relationships, expanding distribution channels, and achieving profitable sales of dates and related products. The position requires over 10 years of experience and offers a salary of SAR 40K – 45K + Benefits. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute annual, quarterly, and monthly sales plans aligned with company revenue and profitability objectives. Expand sales across the KSA market through various channels including wholesalers, distributors, modern trade, traditional trade, retailers, foodservice, hotels, restaurants, cafés, institutions, and B2B customers. Identify and develop new export markets, establishing relationships with international importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and food companies. Manage strategic accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention through regular visits and business reviews. Build a qualified pipeline of new customers and distributors, identifying opportunities for new products, packaging formats, and sales channels. Negotiate prices, payment terms, volumes, contracts, and promotions within approved authority while protecting margins. Lead, coach, and develop the sales team, establishing clear individual and team KPIs and conducting performance reviews. Coordinate with Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Quality, Marketing, and Logistics to meet customer requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Agriculture, Food Science, or a related discipline. Proven and recent sales experience in the dates industry is mandatory. Over 10 years of experience in sales, with a strong understanding of the Saudi dates market. Practical experience with international customers, importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, foodservice companies, or traders. Proven international sales/export experience in dates is strongly preferred. Established relationships with dates buyers, distributors, importers, wholesalers, retailers, traders, or foodservice customers are highly desirable. Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets and developing new accounts. Experience managing a sales team and commercial pipeline. Key Skills and Knowledge Strong practical understanding of the Saudi dates sector, including key producing regions, market channels, customer segments, and seasonal demand. Knowledge of major dates varieties, their commercial positioning, grades, sizes, moisture characteristics, packaging formats, and applications. Understanding of the dates value chain from farm/producer through processing, packing, distribution, wholesale, retail, and export. Ability to understand customer specifications and translate market requirements into commercially viable product offerings. Awareness of international market preferences and the commercial requirements of different export destinations. Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-management skills. Work Environment and Travel This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Regular travel within Saudi Arabia is expected, with international travel as required to visit customers, distributors, importers, and business partners, and to attend exhibitions and trade events.

4d53ac906ef44fc0.description: About the Tamheer Program Internship Al Rajhi Takaful is offering an internship opportunity through the Tamheer Program, supported by the Human Resources Development Fund (HRDF). This program is designed for Saudi graduates seeking to gain practical skills and professional experience in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The internship aims to prepare participants for entry into the job market. Program Overview This internship is structured to provide hands-on experience within a professional work environment at Al Rajhi Takaful. Participants will receive practical training relevant to their field of study, contributing to their professional development. The program duration is 6 months, commencing in October 2026. Key Benefits Acquire practical experience in a corporate setting. Receive specialized training aligned with academic background. Benefit from a monthly stipend provided by HRDF. Obtain a certificate of experience upon successful completion of the internship. Location and Duration The internship will be conducted at Al Rajhi Takaful's offices in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The program has a fixed duration of six months, providing a structured period for learning and professional growth. Candidate Profile This program is open to Saudi graduates with 0-1 years of experience who are seeking to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and practical application in a professional environment. Ideal candidates will be motivated to learn and contribute to the company's operations while developing their professional skills. Application Process Interested Saudi graduates are encouraged to apply for this Tamheer Program internship to gain valuable professional experience with Al Rajhi Takaful.

4d6d350518f3a515.description: نبحث عن أخصائي مبيعات طموح للانضمام إلى فريقنا الديناميكي والمساهمة في تحقيق أهدافنا التجارية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات الفعالة، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وتجاوز توقعاتهم. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وقدرة على الإقناع، وشغفًا بتحقيق النجاح، فإننا ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الفرصة المثيرة. تشمل مهامك الرئيسية: * تطوير وتنفيذ خطط مبيعات مبتكرة لزيادة الإيرادات. * تحديد فرص البيع الجديدة والتواصل مع العملاء المحتملين. * تقديم عروض قيمة للمنتجات أو الخدمات وشرح مزاياها. * بناء والحفاظ على علاقات قوية ومستدامة مع العملاء الحاليين. * متابعة نتائج المبيعات وتحليلها لتقديم تقارير دورية. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة وتقديم أداء متميز.

4d938d4afc2f14e0.description: About the Role NicheHR Global is seeking a Sales Manager to lead business development, strategic client acquisition, sponsorship sales, and revenue growth within the KSA market. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on driving business growth for advisory, leadership development, learning, employee engagement, and people transformation solutions, alongside generating sponsorship revenue for various events. Key Responsibilities Drive revenue growth through new client acquisition, strategic account expansion, and sponsorship sales. Identify and convert new business opportunities across various solutions, including Leadership Development, Executive Coaching, HR Advisory & Consulting, Employee Engagement, Culture Transformation, Learning & Development, Assessment & Development Centers, Capability Building Programs, DEI and Future of Work Initiatives, and HR Strategy and Organizational Development Projects. Build a pipeline of enterprise clients through networking, referrals, and market outreach. Leverage existing industry relationships to create business opportunities and accelerate market penetration. Achieve and exceed sales, sponsorship, and profitability targets for the region. Drive cross-selling and upselling opportunities within existing accounts. Manage sponsorship sales for conferences, HR summits, roundtables, leadership forums, certifications, and flagship events. Develop customized sponsorship pitches and partnership opportunities. Build relationships with HR solution providers, consulting firms, technology organizations, and enterprise brands for long-term partnerships. Develop and nurture senior-level relationships with CHROs, CXOs, Talent Management Heads, L&D Heads, and HR Business Leaders. Lead consultative discussions to understand client challenges and propose customized solutions. Develop and execute regional market expansion strategies. Represent NicheHR Global at HR forums, leadership conferences, and industry events. Collaborate with internal consulting, delivery, event, marketing, and leadership teams to ensure seamless execution. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant sales or business development role. Strong existing network and credibility within the HR and business leadership ecosystem across KSA. Established relationships with CHROs, CXOs, Talent Management Heads, L&D Heads, HR Heads, and business decision-makers across enterprise organizations. Experience in selling HR advisory, leadership development, capability building, employee engagement, culture transformation, or learning solutions. Proven ability to drive sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for conferences and large-scale industry events. Strong consultative selling mindset with the ability to understand business challenges and position strategic people solutions. Ability to independently engage and influence senior stakeholders and leadership teams. Strong commercial acumen with a solution-oriented and revenue-focused approach. High ownership, entrepreneurial mindset, and ability to thrive in a target-driven environment. Excellent networking, relationship-building, and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong presentation, storytelling, and proposal development skills. Ability to collaborate across internal teams and manage multiple strategic accounts simultaneously. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active engagement within the KSA market and collaboration with various internal teams. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4db001109db33f49.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها لضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المرافق. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجداول الزمنية للخدمات وتخطيطها وتحضيرها. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أدائهم لمهام التنظيف اليومية، مثل مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. ضمان تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي بشكل فعال. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الإشراف على خدمات التنظيف والتدبير. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي والصحة والسلامة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تقع في مدينة نجران، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المرافق التجارية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4dc0e36044512603.description: نبحث عن موظف استقبال محترف للانضمام إلى فريق العمل، حيث سيكون مسؤولاً عن استقبال الزوار والعملاء وتوجيههم، والرد على المكالمات الهاتفية وتحويلها للأقسام المختصة، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم المواعيد وإدارة المراسلات الإدارية والعمل في التسويق. المرشح المثالي يجب أن يتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة، وقدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة الحاسوب الأساسية، والحفاظ على المظهر المهني اللائق. نوفر بيئة عمل مريحة وفرص تطوير مهني مع راتب تنافسي ومزايا إضافية.

4d0a45759b559f2b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على مراجعة البيانات وتدقيقها وإدخالها وتخزينها بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمال جميع المعلومات المطلوبة. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات إلى أنظمة الحاسب الآلي باستخدام البرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. تدقيق رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء محتملة لضمان الدقة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وفعالة. إجراء النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. الالتزام الصارم بالتعليمات والسياسات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات أو مجال ذي صلة. مهارات ممتازة في استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. الالتزام بمعايير السرية وحماية المعلومات. بيئة العمل يعمل مدخل البيانات ضمن فريق شركة سراكو في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور المنتظم في مقر العمل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق سراكو، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

4d1f74f1e0c5566a.description: About Ipsen and the Role Ipsen is seeking a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) specializing in Neuroscience to join its Medical Affairs team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, field-based position will focus on the Central Region and provide scientific expertise across both Therapeutic and Aesthetic indications within Neuroscience. The role involves improving patients' lives through innovative medicines and scientific collaboration. Key Responsibilities Build and strengthen peer-to-peer relationships with healthcare professionals, thought leaders, and key medical experts. Lead high-quality, balanced, and evidence-based scientific exchange across Therapeutic and Aesthetic indications. Deliver and support scientific education, injector training, masterclasses, workshops, and expert meetings. Partner with key external experts to advance scientific understanding of toxin mechanisms, anatomy, and treatment outcomes. Gather and communicate medical insights on unmet needs, clinical practice, treatment trends, and the evolving healthcare landscape. Support medical education initiatives, congress activities, advisory boards, and data-generation opportunities. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and cross-functional colleagues, integrating field insights into medical strategy and planning. Maintain high standards of scientific integrity, compliance, and patient focus in all interactions. Qualifications and Requirements A degree in Pharmacy, Medical Sciences, or a related discipline. Pharmaceutical industry experience and a strong understanding of clinical and scientific data. Previous Medical Affairs experience is preferred. Experience or strong scientific knowledge in Neuroscience, Therapeutic, and/or Aesthetic medicine. Excellent communication skills and the ability to build credible scientific relationships with healthcare professionals. The ability and willingness to work extensively in the field and travel regularly as required. Work Environment This is a field-based role within the Medical Affairs team, primarily covering the Central Region of Saudi Arabia. The position requires regular travel and direct engagement with the healthcare community. About Ipsen Ipsen is a science-driven organization focused on innovative medicines and scientific collaboration to improve patients' lives. This role offers the opportunity to connect scientific evidence, medical insights, and education to advance patient care. Application Candidates who are passionate about science, external engagement, and making an impact for patients are encouraged to apply.

4d2e337c38b00849.description: About Botanica Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global's destinations. The company integrates new species with local flora, benefiting from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group. Operating over 1 million square meters, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants since 2020, with a goal of 30 million by 2030, shaping the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. The team includes 40% from the local community, committed to ecological harmony and pioneering sustainable development benchmarks. Role Summary Botanica is seeking a Director Commercial to lead its commercial function. This full-time role is based in Tabuk, specifically covering Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. The Director Commercial will be responsible for growing profitable, contracted revenue across all business lines, including plant and tree supply, contract growing, nursery services, horticultural soil, indoor plants and flowers, agricultural consulting, and landscape maintenance services. The role involves owning the commercial strategy, pricing, tendering, client contracts, and key accounts for both internal clients within Red Sea Global and external developments. The Director Commercial is accountable for ensuring that all client commitments are deliverable by business units and are margin-positive for Botanica. Key Responsibilities Develop the 3–5 year commercial strategy and annual revenue plan, aligned with the Botanica business plan and Red Sea Global Group priorities. Define the product and service portfolio and pricing architecture for each business line. Lead market research and competitor benchmarking; identify new segments and services. Provide monthly demand forecasts to the PMO for sales and operations planning. Build and manage the opportunity pipeline across internal Red Sea Global clients and external developments. Chair bid/no-bid reviews; lead tender strategy and proposal preparation with input from Production, PMO, and Finance. Approve cost build-ups and price-to-win jointly with Finance; ensure proposals meet margin floors. Develop strategic partnerships, distribution channels, and B2B/B2C sales routes for specific products. Own client relationships for all key accounts, internal and external; maintain account plans, SLAs, and periodic performance reviews. Lead negotiation, execution, and renewal of client contracts; manage variations, change orders, and claims. Ensure monthly invoices are backed by verified service evidence jointly with Production. Own account-level collections with Finance; resolve disputed invoices and protect days sales outstanding. Track sales, revenue, and margin against plan; report variances and recovery actions monthly. Lead marketing plans that position Botanica as a trusted supplier, overseeing the plant catalogue, sales collateral, and digital presence. Plan and deliver Botanica tours and visitor experiences for guests, partners, and clients. Build and lead the commercial team, setting objectives, KPIs, and succession plans, including Saudization targets. Own commercial policies, including pricing approval matrix, credit terms, and anti-bribery controls. Follow and enforce all relevant Botanica and Red Sea Global Group policies, processes, and standards. Apply and champion safety, quality, and environmental management systems. Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems and practices. Experience and Qualifications Over 10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to lead commercial functions and drive revenue growth. Experience in developing and implementing commercial strategies, pricing, and tendering processes. Proficiency in managing client contracts and key accounts. Understanding of sales and operations planning, demand forecasting, and financial reporting. Experience in marketing and brand positioning within a B2B and B2C context. Leadership experience in building and managing commercial teams. Knowledge of relevant industry standards (*, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 37301) is beneficial. Work Context Botanica operates as an integrated landscape company with two primary revenue engines: project-based product sales (plants, trees, soil, indoor plants, and flowers) and recurring services (landscape maintenance, nursery management, and consulting). This role serves both internal clients within Red Sea Global and external developments, including hotel operators, developers, and government entities. The Director Commercial must balance growth objectives with the delivery capabilities of the Production units. Key commercial risks include concentration on internal Red Sea Global clients, price pressure on maintenance renewals, and scope creep, which the role must identify and address proactively.

4d57dd7a80a40ce7.description: Odoo ERP Administrator Role Sealy Mattress Middle East is seeking an experienced Odoo ERP Administrator to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah Province. This full-time role involves managing and optimizing the company's ERP infrastructure, ensuring that Odoo modules are aligned with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Manage user roles, security settings, and data backup procedures within the Odoo system. Configure and customize core Odoo modules, including Manufacturing, Inventory, and Accounting, to suit specific manufacturing workflows. Develop custom applications using Python, XML, and JavaScript to extend Odoo functionality. Maintain and troubleshoot integrations with external platforms and devices. Administer PostgreSQL databases to ensure optimal performance and data integrity. Document processes and provide training to end-users on Odoo system usage. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in Odoo ERP administration and related fields. This includes hands-on experience with system management, configuration, and customization. Technical Skills Proficiency in Odoo ERP system administration. Experience with Python, XML, and JavaScript for module development. Strong understanding of database management, particularly PostgreSQL. Knowledge of ERP module integration and API management. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, within the Makkah Province. The role involves working directly with the Middle East Mattress Factory Co. team to enhance and maintain their ERP systems. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4d5f8928d641221d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الأعمال المدنية عن مراقب تعديات وتسريبات مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مراقبة التعديات وتسريبات المياه واتخاذ الإجراءات القانونية والتصحيحية اللازمة بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية للعثور على تسربات المياه والتعديات غير المشروعة على شبكات المياه. ضمان وجود آلية فعالة لقياس مستوى الإنجاز في مهام الكشف عن التسربات والتعديات. إغلاق عداد المياه عن المشتركين الذين تم العثور على تسربات مياه في شبكتهم. تحرير الإشعارات اللازمة ووضعها في مكان ظاهر على منزل المشترك تمهيداً للإصلاحات. القيام بالإجراءات القانونية عند العثور على أي تعدٍ على شبكة المياه وإحالة القضية إلى المختصين. تطبيق السياسات والإجراءات والأنظمة المتبعة في مجال العمل والالتزام بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بمراقبة التعديات أو تسربات المياه. القدرة على تطبيق الإجراءات القانونية والتصحيحية. فهم جيد لسياسات وإجراءات شبكات المياه. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب العمل الميداني لمراقبة شبكات المياه والتعامل مع التعديات والتسربات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4dc0f9c7193f5f8d.description: About Alnafitha IT Alnafitha IT, established in 1993, is a leading independent provider of IT services and solutions in Saudi Arabia. As a Saudi-owned company, it has grown to offer comprehensive IT solutions across various domains, including Microsoft, AWS, ManageEngine, and Zoho Solutions. With over 30 years of experience, Alnafitha IT has completed more than 4,000 projects for over 3,000 customers, focusing on driving digital transformation and operational excellence. The company's vision is to be the Kingdom's most customer-centric provider for digital transformation and consultation, fostering innovation and excellence. The Role of Legal & Contracts Specialist Alnafitha IT is seeking a Legal & Contracts Specialist to provide comprehensive legal support, primarily focusing on commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, corporate governance, employment matters, and dispute management. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The specialist will be responsible for protecting the company’s legal interests, identifying and mitigating legal and contractual risks, and ensuring business operations comply with applicable Saudi Arabian laws and regulations. Key Responsibilities Provide legal advice and opinions to senior management and business functions on legal and commercial matters. Protect the company’s legal position and proactively identify, assess, and mitigate legal, regulatory, and contractual risks. Ensure contracts, agreements, policies, and internal procedures comply with applicable Saudi laws and regulations, including the Companies Law, Labor Law, Civil Transactions Law, and Government Tenders and Procurement Law. Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on commercial agreements, including customer, supplier, partnership, distribution, service, NDA, SLA, and other business-related contracts. Review and assess high-risk contractual provisions such as limitation of liability, indemnities, warranties, penalties, termination, governing law, and dispute resolution clauses, recommending appropriate alternatives. Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Finance, HR, and other departments during contract negotiations and provide legal guidance. Develop, maintain, and periodically update standard contract templates, legal forms, and related documentation. Maintain an effective contracts register and monitor contract status, renewal dates, expiry dates, obligations, and key contractual milestones. Review employment contracts, HR policies, internal regulations, and other employment-related documentation in coordination with Human Resources. Provide legal support on labor disputes and cases, including preparing legal responses, statements of defense, and required documentation. Represent the company before courts, government authorities, and quasi-judicial bodies where legally permitted, or coordinate and supervise external legal counsel. Prepare and review corporate governance documents, including General Assembly minutes, Board resolutions, powers of attorney, and other corporate records. Monitor changes and developments in Saudi laws and regulations and assess their potential impact on the company’s business and operations. Communicate relevant legal and regulatory updates to management and concerned departments and recommend appropriate actions. Support the company in government tenders and procurement matters by reviewing tender-related legal requirements, contractual terms, and obligations. Maintain proper legal documentation and records and ensure confidentiality of sensitive legal and corporate information. Perform any other legal duties and responsibilities assigned by the direct manager. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for the Legal & Contracts Specialist position should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role requires a strong understanding of commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, corporate governance, and employment law within the context of Saudi Arabian legal frameworks. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The specialist will work within a dynamic IT services and solutions environment, collaborating with various internal departments and external legal counsel as needed.

4dda939a69ea3cd0.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Construction Director to join the site team for the Diriyah Boulevard & Public Realm Project. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The project is a key part of Diriyah Gate Phase 2, encompassing iconic parks, open spaces, public realm areas, and over 55 kilometers of streetscape works. The objective is to create an inclusive environment that enhances livability and community well-being. Key Responsibilities Lead, manage, and oversee all construction activities for the Diriyah Boulevard & Public Realm Project. Provide strategic direction and leadership to site construction teams and supervision staff. Ensure construction works are executed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to required quality standards. Coordinate with clients, stakeholders, consultants, and contractors to resolve technical and construction issues. Review and approve construction plans, method statements, and work programs. Monitor progress, identify risks and delays, and implement corrective actions as needed. Ensure full compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) policies and procedures. Oversee contract administration in coordination with commercial and contracts teams. Prepare and present regular progress reports, dashboards, and key metrics to senior management and the client. Support change management, claims avoidance/mitigation, and dispute resolution. Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work culture. Required Experience Candidates must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in construction management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working as part of a dedicated site team on a landmark project. About Parsons Parsons is committed to valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, cultivating an innovative culture that empowers employees to achieve their full potential.

4d3d6edcb28451f5.description: About the Role TK Elevator is seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on driving revenue growth by identifying new business opportunities and managing client relationships within the elevator and escalator solutions sector. The Senior Sales Engineer will deliver tailored solutions for commercial, residential, and industrial construction projects, acting as a key link between clients and internal teams. Role Overview The Senior Sales Engineer combines technical expertise with consultative sales acumen to support developers, architects, and consultants. This position involves understanding customer requirements, presenting appropriate solutions, and ensuring adherence to company safety and compliance standards. The role is critical in securing new installations, modernization projects, and service/maintenance contracts. Key Responsibilities Proactively generate leads and pipeline opportunities for New Installations (NI), Modernization (MOD), or Service/Maintenance contracts. Participate in tenders, prepare comprehensive commercial proposals, and negotiate terms and conditions. Meet with clients, consultants, and contractors to understand requirements and present solutions. Maintain and develop relationships with existing customers and act as a contact between the company and its markets. Negotiate agreements and close sales. Gather market and customer information. Represent the organization at trade exhibitions, events, and demonstrations. Understand TK Elevator products and provide technical support to the sales team during the design phase of projects. Maintain and timely update entries on the VIEW System. Conduct proper analysis for project stages, forecasted VT package awards, and probability of winning. Carry out traffic analysis, determine necessary dimensions to support consultants during design, and advise appropriate solutions. Calculate material costs based on existing tools or factory quotations, and prepare total cost calculations including local costs (installation, local materials). Prepare quotations for clients. Coordinate with other departments (Installation, Projects, Finance, Safety) to prepare all necessary information for quotation/tender submissions, including arranging bonds and special approvals. Adhere to all company safety and compliance rules. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in a sales engineering role. Demonstrated technical expertise combined with consultative sales skills. Proven ability to manage client relationships and identify new business opportunities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working with a diverse range of stakeholders including developers, architects, consultants, and internal engineering/operations teams.

4d49b07dae24d5b7.description: المسمى الوظيفي: بائع الهدف من الوظيفة: دعم العمليات اليومية وتحقيق التميز في خدمة العملاء داخل المعرض، مع الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والمحافظة على النظافة العامة والمظهر الجيد وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة والحفاظ على روح التعاون مع أعضاء الفريق. المساهمة في رفع مبيعات الفرع من خلال متابعة تحقيق الأهداف الشهرية ومقارنتها بالفترة نفسها من العام السابق. الالتزام بساعات العمل الرسمية وبلبس الزي الموحد المعتمد من الشركة. المحافظة على نظافة وتنظيم المعرض في جميع الأوقات. ضمان عدم وجود مخالفات حكومية من خلال الالتزام بجميع التعليمات التشغيلية. متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على تقليلها من خلال تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل فعال ومهارات البيع الالتزام، حسن المظهر وروح الفريق أيام العمل : 6 أيام في الاسبوع الإجازة الاسبوعية: يوم واحد (تكون الإجازة في وسط الاسبوع وليس في الويكيند) العمل بدوام كامل (8 ساعات) (يتم التعيين على شفت واحد سواء مسائي أو صباحي) ☀️ الشفت الصباحي 9 الصباح - 5 المساء 🌙الشفت المسائي 4 مساء - 12 منتصف الليل يمكن أن يتم التنقل بين الفروع القريبة هذه الوظيفة تتطلب استخراج بطاقة صحية (شهادة صحية) بعد التعيين

4d7fbb403dcb42ff.description: نبحث عن مسؤول موارد بشرية ذو خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات الموارد البشرية. ستشمل مسؤولياتك إدارة عمليات التوظيف، وتطوير برامج التدريب، والإشراف على علاقات الموظفين والاحتراف العالي في المنصات الحكوميه لضمان بيئة عمل إيجابية ومنتجة. ندعوك للتقديم إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات قوية في التواصل وحل المشكلات، وشغفاً ببناء فرق عمل ناجحة.

4d125691efbc0ccc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رفاهية الرؤية الطبية عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمساهمة في صياغة الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة لسير العمل. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات لتعزيز جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين وبناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الكتابي والشفوي. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف. القدرة على تطوير برامج ومبادرات لتحسين الجودة. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. التعاون والتنسيق الفعال مع الإدارات المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

4d723be6ca674b7f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سول العربية التجارية عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوصات العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بدقة. معرفة قوية بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة المهنية في شركة سول العربية التجارية.

4dd5de234172a7a7.description: About Fresha Fresha is an AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry. The platform supports businesses in managing operations, fostering growth, and strengthening client relationships. Fresha operates globally with offices across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific, serving over 130,000 beauty and wellness businesses in 120 countries. Role Overview Fresha is seeking an Account Manager to join its commercial team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and expanding a portfolio of Fresha partners within the Arabic-speaking market. The Account Manager will report to the Account Manager Team Lead and will focus on building relationships, understanding partner businesses, and identifying opportunities to increase platform adoption and monetization. This position requires 2-5 years of experience and balances partner experience with revenue growth and retention targets. Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of existing Fresha partners, overseeing monetization, retention, and revenue growth. Analyze account performance to identify opportunities for product adoption, upselling solutions, and increasing monetized revenue. Cultivate long-term relationships with partners through proactive communication and regular video meetings. Implement a consistent contact strategy to maintain partner engagement and identify opportunities to reduce churn. Achieve commercial targets and accurately record account activity, opportunities, and next steps in the CRM. Educate partners on the value of the Fresha platform and ensure they utilize available products and services effectively. Career Development Take ownership of a portfolio of Fresha partners, directly influencing retention, monetization, and revenue growth. Identify and drive opportunities to increase product adoption and enhance business value from Fresha. Develop relationships with business owners and decision-makers across the Arabic-speaking market. Enhance skills in Account Management, upselling, retention, and SaaS commercial growth. Contribute to partner success and Fresha's continued growth in global markets. Work Environment This role is based in the Riyadh office, requiring 5 days per week of in-person interaction and teamwork. The environment values performance, autonomy, and continuous improvement. Candidates who are commercially motivated, proactive, and adept at relationship building while working towards clear targets are encouraged to apply. Application Process Video submissions will be prioritized to expedite the interview process. In your video, please introduce yourself, state your motivations, explain your interest in Fresha, and describe why you are a suitable candidate for this role. Fresha is committed to an inclusive workforce, ensuring fair consideration for all applicants regardless of background or protected characteristics. Accessibility accommodations can be provided upon request.

4d07915599ccf9e4.job_title: Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant Arabic Speaker
4d07915599ccf9e4.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking a Senior Oracle WebLogic Administrator to manage and optimize Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle Fusion Middleware. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves working across on-premises and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments. The role focuses on the middleware lifecycle, including domain provisioning, clustering, performance tuning, patching, security, high availability, disaster recovery, and cloud migration, supporting Oracle application and integration platforms such as E-Business Suite, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus, and Oracle BRM. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, and administer Oracle WebLogic Server 12c and 14c across development, staging, and production environments. Design and manage WebLogic domains, Admin Servers, Managed Servers, clusters, machines, and Node Managers. Configure JDBC data sources, JMS queues and topics, and work managers. Manage security realms, authentication providers, authorization policies, SSL/TLS certificates, and keystores. Deploy and maintain EAR, WAR, and JAR applications, including versioned deployments and rollback procedures. Administer Oracle SOA Suite components (composites, BPEL, Mediator) and Oracle Service Bus services. Manage Oracle HTTP Server, Oracle Traffic Director, and web-tier routing components. Support Oracle Identity and Access Management components (OAM, OIM, OUD, OID). Manage WebLogic and middleware components for Oracle E-Business Suite, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA integrations, and Oracle BRM. Design WebLogic clusters for high availability and implement traffic routing using load balancing tools. Develop and test middleware disaster recovery runbooks across on-premises and OCI environments. Tune JVM heap, garbage collection, thread pools, and work managers for performance and stability. Diagnose performance issues using WLST, WebLogic Diagnostic Framework, and Java Flight Recorder. Plan and execute WebLogic and Fusion Middleware security and release patches. Lead WebLogic and Fusion Middleware upgrades, including migrations from WebLogic 12c to 14c. Migrate WebLogic and Fusion Middleware workloads to OCI Compute, WebLogic for OCI, or container platforms. Automate domain creation, configuration, deployment, and monitoring using WLST, Terraform, and Ansible. Required Qualifications and Experience 8–10 years of Oracle middleware administration experience, with deep hands-on expertise in WebLogic Server 12c and 14c. Strong knowledge of WebLogic domains, clustering, JMS, JDBC, security realms, Node Manager, and deployment models. Experience administering Oracle Fusion Middleware components, including SOA Suite, OSB, OHS, OAM/OIM, and Fusion Middleware Control. Experience supporting middleware for at least two of these application stacks: Oracle E-Business Suite, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, or Oracle BRM. Experience with JVM tuning and WebLogic diagnostics, including thread and heap dump analysis. Experience with WebLogic patching, upgrades, and Middleware home management. Hands-on experience migrating WebLogic workloads to OCI. WLST scripting experience and automation skills using Python, Bash, or Ansible. Working knowledge of Oracle Linux or RHEL. Strong understanding of load balancing, SSL/TLS, DNS, and web-tier architecture. Ability to write clear technical documentation and collaborate with application and infrastructure teams. Preferred Qualifications Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle SOA Suite, or OCI certification. Experience with WebLogic Kubernetes Operator and OKE. Terraform experience with the OCI provider. Experience with Oracle Traffic Director or Oracle Global Load Balancer. Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud and hybrid integrations. Experience integrating WebLogic monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Splunk. Experience with Jenkins, GitLab, ArgoCD, or similar deployment pipelines. Knowledge of OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and Oracle Access Manager. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

4dd67a3745c53244.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة subaie company عن مهندس ميكانيكا للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم وتنفيذ ومتابعة أنظمة التكييف (HVAC)، بهدف ضمان كفاءة التشغيل والالتزام بالمعايير الفنية والهندسية والسلامة. يساهم المهندس في تحقيق أهداف الشركة من خلال تنفيذ المشاريع بجودة عالية وضمن الميزانية والوقت المحددين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم الهندسية لأنظمة التكييف والتبريد والتهوية باستخدام برامج التصميم المتخصصة مثل AutoCAD وRevit MEP. إجراء الحسابات الهندسية للأحمال الحرارية (Heat Load Calculations) واختيار المعدات المناسبة. مراجعة المخططات والمواصفات الفنية للمشاريع والتأكد من مطابقتها للكود السعودي للبناء ومعايير ASHRAE وSMACNA. الإشراف على تركيب وتشغيل واختبار أنظمة التكييف والتبريد في المواقع. إعداد جداول الكميات (BOQ) والمواصفات الفنية وطلبات الشراء للمعدات والمواد. متابعة سير العمل في المشاريع وضمان الالتزام بالجدول الزمني والميزانية المعتمدة. إعداد تقارير فنية دورية ترصد التقدم في التنفيذ والمشكلات الفنية وحلولها. التنسيق مع المقاولين والموردين والاستشاريين ومختلف الجهات ذات العلاقة بالمشروع. وضع وتطبيق برامج الصيانة الوقائية والدورية لأنظمة التكييف والتبريد. التأكد من تطبيق معايير السلامة المهنية والبيئية أثناء التنفيذ والتشغيل. تدريب وتوجيه الفنيين ومتابعة أدائهم في الأعمال الميدانية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال هندسة أنظمة التكييف (HVAC). إتقان استخدام برامج التصميم الهندسي مثل AutoCAD وRevit MEP. معرفة قوية بالكود السعودي للبناء ومعايير ASHRAE وSMACNA. القدرة على إجراء حسابات الأحمال الحرارية واختيار المعدات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة في تنفيذ المشاريع. الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي، بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

4dad07a7eee54fe9.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة صالح هادي صالح ال حيدر وشريكه عن حاجتها لمساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى إدارة البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، وطباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المساعدة الإدارية أو دور مشابه. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية في إدارة البريد والمواعيد اليومية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الشفهي والكتابي. القدرة على تنظيم وتنسيق الاجتماعات بكفاءة. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتحديد الأولويات. بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق عمل في مقر الشركة بالرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بساعات العمل المحددة لضمان استمرارية الدعم الإداري. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

The ideal candidate is a proactive leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for operational excellence in a fast-paced environment. The MIS / Data Analysis Coordinator will be responsible for managing Management Information Systems (MIS), conducting data analysis, and generating insightful reports to support strategic business decisions. This role involves collecting, processing, and validating data, developing automated reports, and working closely with various departments to provide data-driven insights. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, expertise in data management tools, and the ability to communicate complex information effectively. Key Responsibilities Generate reports to track progress and inform decision-making Develop and implement plans to support organizational objectives Monitor and track budgets to ensure financial accountability and transparency Coordinate and facilitate YP training sessions, plan and execute events, and provide administrative support to the VP's office Prepare financial reports and provide insights to support data-driven decision-making Perform data analysis tasks to optimize processes and inform business decisions Ensure compliance with data governance and security policies. Provide training and support to teams on MIS and data analysis tools. Assist in improving data collection procedures and systems. Bachelor’s degree OR Diploma degree in Data Analysis, Data Science, or Business Analytics or MIS. 2+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Data Science, or Business Analytics Proficiency in MS Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Familiarity with data governance and data quality standards. Experience with database management and reporting tools.

4de247d539a54af4.description: Eram Talent is a leading Talent Acquisition Consultancy focused on placing highly skilled professionals in various industries across the globe. We are currently seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator specializing in Drilling Safety and Environment for one of our prominent clients in the oil and gas sector. In this role, the Field Compliance Coordinator will ensure that safety and environmental regulations are adhered to in drilling operations, collaborating closely with field teams, contractors, and management to mitigate risks and promote a safe working environment. Functional Job Title: Drilling Field compliance coordinators (Safety and Environment) JOB DESCRIPTION: The successful candidate will be required to perform the following: Act as the UR Operations Excellence & Compliance Division Field HSE Advisor, EMS focal point, reports to Group Lead and maintains daily communications with assigned departments ops managers to provide key support, in regards of E&OH for field and office activities; Provide field support in regards of daily activities environmental impacts, environmental release events and E&OH audits/inspections; Review the annual environmental objectives and programs (action plans) proposed by UROE&CD with department management and signs off on department approved environmental objectives; Obtains monthly updates from department training coordinator to verify the department’s environmental/ EMS compliance and reports deficiencies, if any, to the group lead; Reviews and reports new (or changes in) departmental processes and/or procedures that may have an environmental impact (adverse or beneficial) and may affect achievement of desired EMS outcomes to UROE&CD; Conduct EMS assessments, E&OH inspections (ECAs, OHHAs, CEHAs, RPAs, NORM surveys and EH surveys) as per schedules; Produce the non-compliance reports and communicate them to unit supervisor; Monitors the performance of Environmental emergency drill scenarios and follows up with any identified deficiencies; Monitor and reports the department daily activities environmental data and performance indicators on Flaring, SO2, Greenhouse gas emissions (GHG), Water Conservation, Energy, etc; and Advice UR Operations on managing environmental risks and provide recommendations to mitigate impacts The successful candidate should hold a Bachelor degree in, Engineering, HSE, Science, Industrial, or in a related discipline from an accredited entity or equivalent. A Master’s Degree in Environment is preferable. Minimum 10 years of experience in environmental compliance related to drilling and completion operations shall demonstrate/prove a high level of Environmental management skills with expertise in oil and gas or other related activities. Certified and/or have knowledge and field experience in Environmental management systems (preferably Internal/Lead audit certifications ISO 14001, other training certifications related to environmental sustainability, air mitigations, hazardous waste, GHG, water/wastewater management, NORM/ radioactive, spill control, noise control, and etc.) preferably to have demonstrated knowledge of delivering hands on environmental training and conducting of different environmental awareness sessions. preferably to have good knowledge of environmental concepts, international environmental standards, and industry related environmental standards, and research methods. Ability to write reports; ability to work with others and communicate technical concepts and ideas to non-technical personnel and the public; ability to read, write, speak, understand, and communicate in English sufficiently to perform the essential duties of the position; ability to use computer applications.

4d68676f861862cf.description: Eram Talent is excited to invite fresh graduates to apply for the position of Civil Engineer - Fresher. You will also have the chance to learn about industry practices, participate in fieldwork, and contribute to innovative solutions that address real-world challenges in civil engineering. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field. Recent graduate GPA - 3 out of 4 or 4 out of 5 Strong understanding of civil engineering principles and practices. Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced work environment. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Proficiency in civil engineering software (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, etc.) is a plus. Strong attention to detail and a proactive attitude.
